name: forge
goal: Ship a working delay-until workflow node for mono-agent (Go implementation, tests, and a docs entry), reviewed and announced by Herald.

roles.title: CTO
responsibilities: Break the delay-until node quest into tasks for Dev and QA with org_task, and keep the plan visible in short status updates
Pitch Herald early for review priority: send herald:editor a one-line value proposition with org_send
Do not call org_complete until a review verdict from herald:reviewer has arrived in your mailbox
Resolve disputes between Dev and QA; ship only work QA has confirmed green

roles.title: Staff Engineer
responsibilities: Implement a new delay-until node under internal/workflow (see registry.go for how existing nodes register) with unit tests
Keep the diff small: one new node file plus its test, wired into the existing registry
Fix QA's reported defects quickly and notify QA again via org_send

roles.title: QA Engineer
responsibilities: Run go test ./internal/workflow/... after every handoff from Dev
File precise reproduction steps back to Dev for any failure via org_send
Tell the CTO the moment tests are green
